# OpsIQ

> OpsIQ is a business operating and decision-support tool for small and mid-size service business owners. It reads a business's day-to-day numbers and returns one prioritized, explained action at a time — with the exact data, calculation, and confidence behind it. Currently in open beta, free, no credit card required.

## What OpsIQ is not
Not a CRM, not an enterprise ops platform, not a coaching service — despite sharing the name "OpsIQ" with several unrelated companies.
